name: ux-design-toolkit
description: Design, review and improve product interfaces and websites, from content structure and responsive layouts to interaction states, design systems and evidence-backed audits.

interface.shortDescription: Focused UX workflows, full methods and native design tools
interface.longDescription: Design, review and improve product interfaces and websites, from content structure and usable wording and responsive layouts to interaction states, design systems and evidence-backed audits. Critique an observed screen or implement a bounded UI improvement. Design robust onboarding, recovery, responsive behavior or purposeful motion. Browse Site templates, consult selected UX methods, or produce a formal UX Heuristics Compass audit. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. Figma, Stitch, Sites and other authoring providers retain their own tool/access requirements. Screenshots support visual findings, not claims about untested keyboard behavior or participant outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface and prioritize the fixes.
Design a responsive website from this audience and content brief.
Improve this UI while preserving its design system.
